children: Organigram will acquire all Aurora shares for consideration valued at C$7.80 per share, subject to shareholder, court and regulatory approvals. Shareholders will vote on December 23, 2026; closing is anticipated in January 2027.
Aurora deal consideration valued at C$7.80/share
Sets the transaction value; the release states this is approximately a 93% premium to Aurora's unaffected August 10, 2026 closing price.
Aurora holders may elect cash, shares, or both
Cash and share elections are subject to proration for the all-cash and all-share options, affecting the consideration ultimately received.
Potential cost and revenue benefits support the deal rationale, but remain forward-looking and depend on completion and realization.
Both shareholder approvals remain key closing conditions; the release anticipates completion in January 2027, subject to required approvals.
Aurora holders expected to own 37% economically
The stated pro forma ownership indicates meaningful dilution for Organigram shareholders; Aurora holders are also expected to hold 41% of voting interest.

This is a defined transaction moving from the previously announced agreement toward shareholder approval, rather than a newly announced deal. The next catalysts are the December 23 shareholder votes and required court and regulatory approvals before the anticipated January 2027 closing.
